objectives.text: AML programs are to detect and cause reporting of suspicious transactions and achieve compliance with the Bank Secrecy Act and its implementing regulations.

citations.quote: written anti-money laundering program reasonably designed to achieve and monitor its compliance with the requirements of the Bank Secrecy Act (31 U.S.C. 5311, et seq.), and the implementing regulations promulgated thereunder by the Department of the Treasury

obligations.action: develop and implement a written anti-money laundering program reasonably designed to achieve and monitor its compliance with the requirements of the Bank Secrecy Act and the implementing regulations promulgated thereunder by the Department of the Treasury

citations.quote: Each capital acquisition broker shall develop and implement a written anti-money laundering program reasonably designed to achieve and monitor its compliance with the requirements of the Bank Secrecy Act (31 U.S.C. 5311, et seq.), and the implementing regulations promulgated thereunder by the Department of the Treasury.

obligations.actor: Each capital acquisition broker (via a member of senior management)
obligations.action: have its anti-money laundering program approved, in writing, by a member of senior management

citations.quote: Each capital acquisition broker's anti-money laundering program must be approved, in writing, by a member of senior management.

obligations.actor: Each capital acquisition broker (via its AML program)
obligations.action: establish and implement policies and procedures that can be reasonably expected to detect and cause the reporting of transactions required under 31 U.S.C. 5318(g) and the implementing regulations thereunder

citations.quote: Establish and implement policies and procedures that can be reasonably expected to detect and cause the reporting of transactions required under 31 U.S.C. 5318(g) and the implementing regulations thereunder;

obligations.actor: Each capital acquisition broker (via its AML program)
obligations.action: establish and implement policies, procedures, and internal controls reasonably designed to achieve compliance with the Bank Secrecy Act and the implementing regulations thereunder

citations.quote: Establish and implement policies, procedures, and internal controls reasonably designed to achieve compliance with the Bank Secrecy Act and the implementing regulations thereunder;

obligations.actor: Each capital acquisition broker (via its AML program)
obligations.action: provide for independent testing for compliance, to be conducted by capital acquisition broker personnel or by a qualified outside party
obligations.threshold: no less frequently than every two years

citations.quote: Provide for independent testing for compliance, no less frequently than every two years, to be conducted by capital acquisition broker personnel or by a qualified outside party;

obligations.actor: Each capital acquisition broker (via its AML program)
obligations.action: designate and identify to FINRA (by name, title, mailing address, e-mail address, telephone number, and facsimile number) an individual or individuals responsible for implementing and monitoring the day-to-day operations and internal controls of the program, and provide prompt notification to FINRA regarding any change in such designation(s)

citations.quote: Designate and identify to FINRA (by name, title, mailing address, e-mail address, telephone number, and facsimile number) an individual or individuals responsible for implementing and monitoring the day-to-day operations and internal controls of the program
provide prompt notification to FINRA regarding any change in such designation(s);

obligations.action: be an associated person of the capital acquisition broker

citations.quote: such individual or individuals must be an associated person of the capital acquisition broker

obligations.actor: Each capital acquisition broker (via its AML program)
obligations.action: provide ongoing training for appropriate personnel

citations.quote: Provide ongoing training for appropriate personnel; and

obligations.actor: Each capital acquisition broker (via its AML program)
obligations.action: include appropriate risk-based procedures for conducting ongoing customer due diligence, including understanding the nature and purpose of customer relationships for developing a customer risk profile, and conducting ongoing monitoring to identify and report suspicious transactions and, on a risk basis, to maintain and update customer information

citations.quote: Include appropriate risk-based procedures for conducting ongoing customer due diligence, to include, but not be limited to:
Understanding the nature and purpose of customer relationships for the purpose of developing a customer risk profile; and
Conducting ongoing monitoring to identify and report suspicious transactions and, on a risk basis, to maintain and update customer information.

obligations.action: undertake more frequent testing than required if circumstances warrant

citations.quote: All capital acquisition brokers should undertake more frequent testing than required if circumstances warrant.

obligations.action: have independent testing pursuant to Rule 331(c) conducted by a designated person with a working knowledge of applicable requirements under the Bank Secrecy Act and its implementing regulations

citations.quote: Independent testing, pursuant to Rule 331(c), must be conducted by a designated person with a working knowledge of applicable requirements under the Bank Secrecy Act and its implementing regulations.

obligations.action: have independent testing conducted by a person who performs the functions being tested, the designated anti-money laundering compliance person, or a person who reports to either of those persons

citations.quote:
Independent testing may not be conducted by:

(1) a person who performs the functions being tested,

(2) the designated anti-money laundering compliance person, or

(3) a person who reports to a person described in either subparagraphs (1) or (2) above.

obligations.action: identify, review, and, if necessary, update the information regarding its anti-money laundering compliance person designated pursuant to Rule 331(d) in the manner prescribed by FINRA Rule 4517

citations.quote: Each capital acquisition broker must identify, review, and, if necessary, update the information regarding its anti-money laundering compliance person designated pursuant to Rule 331(d) in the manner prescribed by FINRA Rule 4517.
Each capital acquisition broker shall develop and implement a written anti-money laundering program

definitions.definition: (undefined here) — a written program reasonably designed to achieve and monitor compliance with the Bank Secrecy Act and its implementing regulations, approved in writing by a member of senior management, meeting the minimum elements in (a)–(f)

citations.quote: written anti-money laundering program reasonably designed to achieve and monitor its compliance with the requirements of the Bank Secrecy Act
such individual or individuals must be an associated person of the capital acquisition broker
Understanding the nature and purpose of customer relationships for the purpose of developing a customer risk profile

definitions.definition: for purposes of paragraph (f)(ii), shall include information regarding the beneficial owners of legal entity customers (as defined in 31 CFR 1010.230(e))

citations.quote: For purposes of paragraph (f)(ii), customer information shall include information regarding the beneficial owners of legal entity customers (as defined in 31 CFR 1010.230(e)).

definitions.definition: as defined in 31 CFR 1010.230(e) (definition not restated here)

citations.quote: the beneficial owners of legal entity customers (as defined in 31 CFR 1010.230(e))
to be conducted by capital acquisition broker personnel or by a qualified outside party
the designated anti-money laundering compliance person

interactions.description: The AML program must be reasonably designed to achieve and monitor compliance with the Bank Secrecy Act (31 U.S.C. 5311, et seq.) and the implementing regulations promulgated thereunder by the Department of the Treasury.

citations.quote: reasonably designed to achieve and monitor its compliance with the requirements of the Bank Secrecy Act (31 U.S.C. 5311, et seq.), and the implementing regulations promulgated thereunder by the Department of the Treasury

interactions.description: Policies and procedures must be reasonably expected to detect and cause reporting of transactions required under 31 U.S.C. 5318(g) and its implementing regulations.

citations.quote: detect and cause the reporting of transactions required under 31 U.S.C. 5318(g) and the implementing regulations thereunder

interactions.description: Customer information includes information regarding beneficial owners of legal entity customers as defined in 31 CFR 1010.230(e).

citations.quote: the beneficial owners of legal entity customers (as defined in 31 CFR 1010.230(e))

interactions.description: Review/update of AML compliance person information is to be done in the manner prescribed by FINRA Rule 4517.

citations.quote: in the manner prescribed by FINRA Rule 4517

interactions.description: Independent testing exclusion cross-references subparagraphs (1) and (2) within Supplementary Material .01(c).

citations.quote: a person who reports to a person described in either subparagraphs (1) or (2) above

notes: Modalities: 'shall' and 'must' mapped to must; 'may not' mapped to must_not; 'should' mapped to should. The minimum program elements in (a)-(f) are introduced by 'must, at a minimum,' and are extracted as separate must obligations. Rule 331(d) 'provide prompt notification' phrasing split into a second quote to satisfy length limit; treated as part of the same must duty. Rule text pinned to Nov 19, 2018 onwards version; page footer dated 2026 FINRA.
